::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot"}
#docs
`status` is `not_connected` until an install completes; `authorize_url` is the HubSpot install URL without `state`, which the caller adds.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `status` | `string` | The connection's status. One of `not_connected`, `active`, `reauth_required`. |
| `configured` | `boolean` | Whether this deployment has a HubSpot app configured. |
| `authorize_url` | `string` | The URL that starts the HubSpot authorization. |
| `id` | `string` | The HubSpot connection's id. |
| `portal_id` | `string` | The connected HubSpot account's id. |
| `hub_domain` | `string` | The connected HubSpot account's domain. |
| `installed_by` | `string` | Who connected the account. |
| `scopes` | `array of string` | The permissions granted by HubSpot. |
| `autosync` | `boolean` | Whether changes sync to HubSpot automatically. |
| `initial_sync` | `string` | `pending` until the first sync is started; nothing syncs before that. One of `pending`, `queued`, `running`, `done`. |
| `last_sync_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the last sync finished (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `last_error` | `string` | The last sync error, if any. |
| `connected_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the account was connected (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `health` | `object` | How the sync is doing. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/integrations/hubspot" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
